primary: profile_half: per-account short-segment capacity profiling; rounded-endpoint GLS; Student-t4 working loss; learning rate 0.5; drift 0.15
sensitivity: same core at drift 0 and 0.4; observed capacity estimates with >=50% relative uncertainty used only in a labelled auxiliary comparison
selection_reason: Development comparisons favor half-power robust profile evidence over directly treating particle/constant capacity estimates as truth. Profile evidence admits all contributions while preserving unknown account scales. No local sample-size or local-rank selection. Auxiliary estimated capacities remain useful but endogenous estimates are not independent labels.
caveats: Profile loss is a working generalized likelihood, not a guarantee of calibrated causal probabilities. All-single-interval/free-capacity and collinear designs remain unidentified; evidence from incomplete inputs is not invented. Wrong controlled assumptions and systematic missing use can bias pooled answers. Report all heldout failures; do not retune on evaluation seeds.
